name: moomoo
description: Connect moomoo to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use moomoo MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect moomoo to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with market quotes and brokerage account using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my moomoo workspace.
Find anything in moomoo that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review market quotes and brokerage account in moomoo.
